item.title: "South Korean Companies, Now Is the Time to Come: The 890 Trillion Won Ukraine Reconstruction Project" (“890조원 우크라 재건 사업 한국기업들 지금 바로 오라”)
item.description:
"South Korean Companies, Now Is the Time to Come: The 890 Trillion Won Ukraine Reconstruction Project" (“890조원 우크라 재건 사업 한국기업들 지금 바로 오라”)

Senior Ukrainian officials, participating in a series of sessions on Ukraine’s reconstruction at the Asian Leadership Conference (ALC) held on the 20th and 21st, proposed that South Korean companies actively invest in Ukraine’s reconstruction market, which amounts to $588 billion (approximately 890 trillion won). With companies from the United States and Europe already entering Ukraine and actively collaborating with local businesses, they urged South Korean firms not to miss this business opportunity. (우크라이나 고위 관계자들은 20~21일 열린 아시안리더십콘퍼런스(ALC)의 우크라이나 재건 관련 연쇄 세션에 참가해 “한국 기업들이 5880억달러(약 890조원)에 달하는 우크라 재건 시장에 적극 투자해 달라”고 제안했다. 미국·유럽 등 기업들이 이미 우크라이나에 진출해 현지 기업들과 활발하게 협력하고 있는 상황에서, 한국 기업들이 ‘사업 기회’를 놓치지 말라는 것이다.)

Vitaliy Kim, Governor of Ukraine’s Mykolaiv region, stated during the session titled "Europe After Ukraine: A New Order of Security, Reconstruction, and Growth" on the 20th that "the Ukraine reconstruction project is the largest investment project since the post-World War II recovery efforts," adding, "Many companies are participating in the reconstruction, and South Korean companies also need to explore markets of interest." He cited an example from 2023, when Danish wind turbine manufacturer Vestas partnered with Ukrainian energy company DTEK to install a 114 MW wind power facility, with additional contracts expanding the scale to approximately 500 MW. (비탈리 김 우크라이나 미콜라이우주(州) 주지사는 20일 ‘우크라이나 이후의 유럽: 안보, 재건, 성장의 새로운 질서’ 세션에서 “우크라이나 재건 프로젝트는 2차 세계대전 (복구 사업) 이래 가장 큰 투자 프로젝트”라며 “많은 기업들이 재건에 참여하고 있고, 한국 기업들도 관심 있는 시장을 탐색할 필요가 있다”고 말했다. 그러면서 2023년 덴마크의 풍력 터빈 제조사 베스타스가 우크라이나 에너지 회사 DTEK와 협력해 114㎿(메가와트) 규모의 풍력 발전 시설을 설치했고, 추가 계약을 통해 그 규모를 약 500㎿로 늘리고 있는 사례 등을 언급했다.)

Tetiana Prokopchuk, Vice President of the American Chamber of Commerce in Ukraine, noted, "In Ukraine’s reconstruction market, expected to reach $588 billion (about 890 trillion won) over the next decade, five sectors—housing, energy, transportation, commerce, and agriculture—account for approximately $400 billion (about 610 trillion won)." She emphasized, "Capital follows opportunity, and opportunity follows scale," suggesting this is a prime chance for large-scale investment. Last year, the United States and Ukraine agreed to establish the "U.S.-Ukraine Reconstruction Investment Fund (URIF)" to foster energy and logistics enterprises, jointly contributing an initial capital of $150 million. (테타냐 프로콥추크 우크라이나 주재 미국상공회의소 부회장은 “우크라이나에서 향후 10년간 예상되는 5880억달러(약 890조원) 재건 시장에서 주택·에너지·운송·상업·농업 등 5개 부문이 약 4000억달러(약 610조원)를 차지한다”며 “자본은 기회를 따라가고, 기회는 규모를 따라간다”고 말했다. 대규모 투자를 할 수 있는 좋은 기회라는 것이다. 작년 미국과 우크라이나는 에너지·물류 기업 육성을 위한 ‘미국·우크라이나 재건 투자 기금(URIF)’을 만들기로 합의하고, 초기 자본금으로 1억5000만달러를 공동 출자했다.)

Prokopchuk also stated, "According to a survey of around 600 local chamber member companies, 61% of members plan to expand their businesses in Ukraine this year." While the war has significantly impacted local businesses, this indicates an optimistic outlook for future recovery. She added, "Investing in Ukraine is not charity; it is clearly a business." According to foreign media, U.S. companies in diverse sectors such as Westinghouse (nuclear power), Cargill (agriculture), and Microsoft (IT) have been consistently investing in Ukraine in recent years. (프로콥추크 부회장은 “현지 (미 상공회의소) 회원사 600여곳을 상대로 한 설문조사에 따르면, 회원사 61%가 올해 우크라이나에서 사업을 확대할 계획”이라고도 했다. 전쟁으로 현지 기업들이 상당한 타격을 받은 것은 사실이지만, 그만큼 향후 회복세를 낙관적으로 전망한다는 것이다. 그는 “우크라이나 투자는 자선(charity)이 아닌, 분명한 사업(business)”이라고도 했다. 외신 등에 따르면, 최근 수년간 웨스팅하우스(원전), 카길(농업), 마이크로소프트(IT) 등 다양한 분야의 미국 기업들도 우크라이나에 꾸준히 투자해 왔다.)

It was also noted that despite Ukraine being at war, its basic public systems are functioning normally. Roksolana Pidlasa, Chair of the Budget Committee of the Ukrainian Parliament, stated, "The government is performing its functions and is financially sound, with all public services being provided promptly." She explained that the push for digitalization of public services during the COVID-19 crisis in 2020, along with the relocation of key government offices to western Ukraine after the outbreak of war, has helped maintain the public systems. (우크라이나가 전쟁 중이지만, 기본적인 공공 시스템은 정상 가동되고 있다는 점도 언급됐다. 록솔라나 피들라사 우크라이나 의회 예산위원장은 “정부는 제 기능을 수행하고 있고 재정적으로도 건전하다”며 “모든 정부 서비스가 신속하게 제공되고 있다”고 했다. 2020년 코로나 위기 때 공공 서비스 디지털화를 본격적으로 추진했고, 전쟁 발발 이후 주요 관공서를 우크라이나 서부로 이동시킨 덕분에 공공 시스템이 유지될 수 있었다는 설명이다.)

Some participants suggested that South Korea, which achieved rapid growth from the ruins of the Korean War, serves as a "model case" for Ukraine. Svitlana Kovalchuk, Secretary General of the Yalta European Strategy (YES) in Ukraine, said during the session "Ukraine’s Reconstruction and Industrial Transformation: Strategic Cooperation between South Korea and Ukraine," "South Korea grew from a completely devastated country into one of the most influential economic leaders within a single generation," calling it "a very significant example." She highlighted that South Korea’s establishment of various export industrial complexes in the 1960s serves as a valuable reference for Ukraine’s reconstruction process. (6·25전쟁의 폐허로부터 고도 성장한 한국이 우크라이나에 ‘모범 케이스’가 된다는 의견도 있었다. 스비틀라나 코발추크 우크라이나 얄타유럽전략(YES) 사무총장은 ‘우크라이나 재건과 산업 전환: 한국·우크라이나 전략적 협력’ 세션에서 “한국은 완전히 황폐화된 국가에서 한 세대 만에 가장 영향력 있는 경제 선도국 가운데 하나로 성장했다”며 “매우 큰 본보기”라고 했다. 특히 1960년대 한국이 각종 수출 산업단지를 조성한 것이 우크라이나 재건 과정에서 좋은 참고가 된다고 했다.)

There was also an opinion that investing in Ukraine’s defense sector could improve South Korea’s military technology. Governor Vitaliy Kim remarked, "We are gaining many new experiences on the battlefield right now," and added, "Collaborating with technologically advanced South Korean defense companies could be mutually beneficial." (방산 분야에서 우크라이나에 투자하는 것이 한국의 군사 기술을 개선시킬 수 있다는 의견도 나왔다. 비탈리 김 주지사는 “우리는 지금 전장에서 많은 새로운 경험을 하고 있다”며 “기술적으로 뛰어난 한국 방산 기업과 협력하면 서로에게 이익이 될 수 있을 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: MBC Edits Out Only Kim Tae-heum’s Opening Remarks in TV Debate (MBC, TV토론회서 김태흠 모두 발언만 통편집)
item.description:
MBC Edits Out Only Kim Tae-heum’s Opening Remarks in TV Debate (MBC, TV토론회서 김태흠 모두 발언만 통편집)

Daejeon MBC is facing controversy after airing a recorded TV debate for Chungcheongnam-do governor candidates, where only the opening remarks of People Power Party candidate Kim Tae-heum were deleted. Daejeon MBC apologized, calling it an "editing mistake," but the People Power Party argues that "editing TV debate footage itself violates the Public Official Election Act." (대전 MBC가 충남지사 후보 TV 토론회 녹화본을 방영할 때 국민의힘 김태흠 후보의 모두 발언만 삭제·방영해 논란이 되고 있다. 대전 MBC는 “편집상 실수”라고 사과했으나, 국민의힘은 “TV 토론 영상을 편집하는 것 자체가 공직선거법 위반”이라고 반발했다.)

Daejeon MBC recorded the debate featuring Chungcheongnam-do governor candidates at 3 PM on the 21st. The recorded footage was later broadcast on TV and YouTube at 9 PM that same day. However, while the opening remarks of Democratic Party candidate Park Soo-hyun were included, Kim’s opening remarks were cut out. (대전 MBC는 지난 21일 오후 3시에 충남지사 후보 초청 토론회를 녹화했다. 이후 녹화본을 그날 오후 9시에 TV와 유튜브로 중계했다. 그런데 더불어민주당 박수현 후보의 모두 발언은 나왔는데, 김 후보의 모두 발언은 삭제됐다.)

Kim’s campaign said on the 22nd, "The broadcaster arbitrarily edited a specific candidate's message and deprived voters of their opportunity to judge." The People Power Party’s media special committee called it "a blatant intervention in the election." The election law stipulates that when broadcasting facilities host or air debates or discussions, they must not edit the content. People Power Party representative Jang Dong-hyuk stated that day, "Editing and airing it that way was 200% intentional." (김 후보 캠프는 22일 “방송사가 자의적으로 특정 후보의 메시지를 편집하고 유권자의 판단 기회를 빼앗았다”고 했다. 국민의힘 미디어특위는 “노골적인 선거 개입”이라고 했다. 선거법에는 방송 시설이 대담·토론회를 개최·방송할 때는 내용을 편집해 방송하면 안 된다고 규정돼 있다. 국민의힘 장동혁 대표는 이날 “편집해서 내보낸 건 200% 의도적”이라고 했다.)

Daejeon MBC initially posted an apology on the morning of that day, stating it was "a mistake that occurred during the post-editing process of a single NG cut from the recording," but later that afternoon changed its explanation to "a mistake that occurred while correcting a caption error in Kim’s name." In response, Jang Dong-hyuk said on Facebook, "They even put out a false apology, and when challenged, they revised it? Trying to pass off ‘intent’ as a ‘mistake’ only ties their words in knots. It’s essentially a confession of a crime." The People Power Party filed a complaint against Daejeon MBC for violating the election law. Daejeon MBC re-aired the debate that evening, including Kim’s opening remarks. (대전 MBC는 이날 오전 사과문을 올리면서 “녹화 과정에서 생긴 NG컷 1개를 후편집하는 과정에서 생긴 실수”라고 했다가, 이날 오후엔 “김 후보 이름의 자막 오류를 바로잡는 과정에서 생긴 실수”라고 해명을 바꿨다. 그러자 장동혁 대표는 페이스북에서 “사과문까지 거짓말로 내놓고, 반박하니 수정? ‘고의’를 ‘실수’로 바꾸려니 말이 꼬인다. 사실상 범죄 자백”이라고 했다. 국민의힘은 대전 MBC를 선거법 위반으로 고발했다. 대전 MBC는 이날 저녁 김 후보 모두 발언을 넣은 토론회를 재방영했다.)

item.title: PPP’s Busan Candidates Growing Anxious… Jang Dong-hyuk Draws Line on Unification in Buk-gu Gap (국힘 부산 출마자들은 속 타는데… 장동혁, 북갑 단일화에 선 그어)
item.description:
PPP’s Busan Candidates Growing Anxious… Jang Dong-hyuk Draws Line on Unification in Buk-gu Gap (국힘 부산 출마자들은 속 타는데… 장동혁, 북갑 단일화에 선 그어)

People Power Party (PPP) leader Jang Dong-hyuk on the 22nd referred to independent candidate Han Dong-hoon, who is running in the Buk-gu Gap by-election for the National Assembly, as “someone who ruined conservatism.” The Buk-gu Gap National Assembly election is set to be a three-way race between Democratic Party of Korea candidate Ha Jung-woo, PPP candidate Park Min-shik, and independent Han Dong-hoon. Amid growing calls from some opposition circles for Park Min-shik and Han Dong-hoon to unify, Rep. Jang reaffirmed the party’s position against unification. <<> On the YouTube channel of the Maeil Shinmun that day, Jang said of Han, “Can a person who ruined conservatism convince the public that he will rebuild it?” He also commented on Park Min-shik’s shaved head at his campaign kickoff the previous day, saying, “Busan Buk-gu had been bogged down by the unification issue, but from yesterday onward, it’s been getting back on track.” On SBS Radio, Park explained his shaved head as “a message that unification with Han, a traitor to conservatism, is not possible.” <<> Han Dong-hoon also wrote on Facebook that day, “Jang Dong-hyuk’s faction and candidate Park Min-shik are only attacking me, effectively campaigning for the Democratic Party candidate.” He further posted a video showing Shin Dong-wook, a PPP Supreme Council member who had been campaigning with Park Min-shik, greeting Ha Jung-woo at a restaurant in Busan, and remarked, “It wasn’t just ‘Go Ha Jung-woo,’ but also ‘Let’s do well, our candidate Ha Jung-woo.’ Jang Dong-hyuk’s faction should just declare support for Democratic candidate Ha Jung-woo.” In response, Supreme Council member Shin said, “I offered words of encouragement, thinking it must be tough for him in his first election. I would have said the same to Han Dong-hoon if I had met him.” <<> As tensions escalate between the two candidates, concerns are growing among PPP candidates in the Busan region, including Busan mayoral candidate Park Hyung-joon. Rep. Park Soo-young, a former member of the pro-Yoon faction, recently wrote in a PPP lawmakers’ group chat, “My district, Busan Nam-gu, is typically a place where we win by 10 to 15 percentage points, but now we’re in a tight race of disadvantage. Without special measures from the Busan city party and the central party to turn the tide, the election will be difficult.” (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 22일 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마한 무소속 한동훈 후보에 대해 “보수를 망가뜨린 사람”이라고 했다. 부산 북갑 국회의원 선거는 더불어민주당 하정우 후보, 국민의힘 박민식 후보, 무소속 한동훈 후보의 3파전으로 치러진다. 야권 일각에서 박민식, 한동훈 후보가 단일화해야 한다는 의견이 나오는 가운데 장 대표가 단일화 불가 입장을 재확인한 것이다.)

item.title: "Semiconductors, Supply Chains, and AI Are the Driving Force… Now Is the Era of Economic Alliances" (“반도체·공급망·AI가 힘… 이젠 경제동맹 시대”)
item.description:
"Semiconductors, Supply Chains, and AI Are the Driving Force… Now Is the Era of Economic Alliances" (“반도체·공급망·AI가 힘… 이젠 경제동맹 시대”)

Diplomatic and security experts from U.S. think tanks stated, "The U.S. will continue to maintain overwhelming military power as the world's top power, but it won't cover everything," adding, "South Korea's role must expand well beyond being centered on North Korea." (미국 싱크탱크 소속 외교·안보 전문가들은 “미국은 앞으로도 세계 제1 강국으로서 압도적 군사력을 유지하겠지만 모든 곳을 다 챙기진 않을 것”이라며 “한국의 역할도 대북 중심에서 벗어나 더 크게 확장해야 한다”고 했다.)

Experts from four major U.S. think tanks—the Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS), RAND Corporation, Brookings Institution, and Hudson Institute—delivered this assessment during four consecutive sessions at the Asian Leadership Conference (ALC) on the 20th and 21st, regarding the rapidly changing international situation following the inauguration of the second Trump administration and the Korea-U.S. alliance. Mick Mulvaney, former White House Chief of Staff under President Trump and an ALC speaker, also predicted, "'America First' is not merely President Trump's personal political slogan. Even after Trump, the non-interventionist foreign policy stance implied by this slogan will continue on a bipartisan basis, with only subtle changes in expression." (전략국제문제연구소(CSIS)·랜드(RAND)·브루킹스·허드슨 등 미 4대 싱크탱크 전문가들은 20~21일 아시안리더십콘퍼런스(ALC)의 4차례 연쇄 세션에서 트럼프 2기 행정부 출범 이후 급변하는 국제 정세와 한·미 동맹 등과 관련, 이 같은 진단을 내놓았다. ALC 연사로 참여한 믹 멀베이니 전 트럼프 대통령 비서실장도 “‘아메리칸 퍼스트(미국 우선주의)’는 트럼프 대통령의 개인적인 정치 구호에 그치는 것이 아니다”라며 “트럼프 이후에도 이 구호가 내포한 미국의 비(非)개입주의적 대외 정책 기조는 표현 방식만 미묘하게 달라질 뿐 초당적으로 이어질 것”이라고 전망했다.)

The experts noted that U.S. hegemony, maintained for about 30 years since the Cold War, is shifting to a 'strategy of preserving hegemony.' Andrew Yeo, the SK-Korea Foundation Chair at Brookings, said, "The U.S. values alliances and the liberal international order, but won't see them as ends in themselves. It will weigh costs and efficiency more, seeking to combine forces with allies as economic security and supply chain partners." Joseph Yun, former acting U.S. Ambassador to South Korea, added, "The Korea-U.S. alliance is evolving and must do so. It can no longer remain solely focused on North Korea." Mark Cozad, a senior security policy researcher at RAND, stated, "The Korea-U.S. alliance is becoming part of a global security network." <<> The shift in the concept of traditional alliances and security from the military domain to economics and science and technology was also emphasized. Patrick Cronin, Chair of Asia-Pacific Security at Hudson, said, "Semiconductors, rare earths, supply chains, and AI infrastructure are no longer just economic issues. They are becoming means of national power." He added, "The 'interdependence' formed by the securitization of economy and technology changes the concept of alliances, not only fostering bond and stability among allies but also serving as a leverage of power to deter rival forces." This suggests that if Korea and the U.S. build cooperative networks in cutting-edge technology fields like semiconductors and AI, they can also reap security benefits. <<> Heino Klinck, a RAND International Defense researcher and former U.S. Deputy Assistant Secretary of Defense for East Asia, said, "Alliances are being redefined around substantive national interests and economic security rather than values or ideology. What matters is whether an alliance generates economic, technological, and political outcomes." <<> Arguments were also made for revising the Korea-U.S. policy toward North Korea. Victor Cha, CSIS Korea Chair, stated, "North Korea has advanced its nuclear capabilities and strengthened military cooperation with Russia. North Korea is no longer the same as before." item.title: To End ‘Switch-Up’ Controversy… Advance Voting Ballot Box Stands to Become Transparent (바꿔치기 논란 더는 안 나오게… 사전투표함 받침대 투명해진다)
item.description:
To End ‘Switch-Up’ Controversy… Advance Voting Ballot Box Stands to Become Transparent (바꿔치기 논란 더는 안 나오게… 사전투표함 받침대 투명해진다)

Starting with this June 3 local election, the external stands for advance voting ballot boxes will be made of transparent material. This is aimed at blocking suspicions of election fraud, such as ballot box swapping. Advance voting for the June 3 local elections will take place over two days, from 6 a.m. to 6 p.m. on the 29th and 30th. (이번 6·3 지방선거부터 사전투표함 외부 받침대가 투명한 재질로 바뀐다. ‘투표함 바꿔치기’ 등 부정선거 의혹을 차단하겠다는 취지다. 6·3 지방선거 사전투표는 오는 29·30일 이틀간 오전 6시부터 오후 6시까지 진행된다.)

The National Election Commission (NEC) uses bag-type ‘sack-style ballot boxes’ for advance voting within the same district, as they are easy to store and transport. At polling stations, a plastic stand covers the sack to prevent it from tipping over, and later only the sack ballot box is removed to count the votes. (중앙선거관리위원회는 관내 사전투표 때 자루 형태의 ‘행낭식 투표함’을 쓰고 있다. 보관과 이동이 쉽기 때문이다. 투표소에선 자루가 쓰러지지 않도록 행낭을 감싸는 플라스틱 받침대를 씌우고, 나중에 행낭 투표함만 꺼내 표를 센다.)

An NEC official said on the 22nd, “The existing stands were opaque, so the sack-style ballot boxes were not visible. This led some voters to misunderstand that the ballot box differed when voting and when counting, so we decided to improve it.” Since only the stand becomes transparent and the sack-style ballot box remains unchanged, the ballots will not be visible from the outside. (선관위 관계자는 22일 “기존 받침대는 불투명해 행낭식 투표함이 보이지 않다 보니 일부 유권자가 투표할 때와 개표할 때 투표함이 달라졌다는 오해가 있어 개선하기로 했다”고 했다. 받침대만 투명하게 바뀌고 행낭식 투표함은 그대로 있기 때문에 투표용지가 외부에서 보이지는 않는다.)

The NEC also decided to improve the design of the advance voting ballot box stand. On the existing stand, the part where the seal is attached was close to the handle and had a step, which has now been made flat. Election officials occasionally damaged the seal while moving the ballot box, and some raised suspicions of intentional damage. Real-time footage from security cameras at advance voting ballot box storage locations will also be displayed on large monitors installed at provincial and city election commissions. (선관위는 사전투표함 받침대 디자인도 개선하기로 했다. 기존 받침대의 경우 봉인지를 붙이는 부분이 손잡이와 가깝고 단차도 있었는데 이를 평평하게 바꿨다. 선거 사무원들이 투표함을 옮기다 봉인지가 훼손되는 경우가 간혹 있었는데, 일각에서 고의 훼손 의혹을 제기하기도 했다. 사전투표함 보관장소의 방범 카메라 실시간 영상도 시·도 선관위에 설치된 대형 모니터를 통해 공개한다.)

The NEC changed the material and design of the advance voting stands to dispel various suspicions as the proportion of voters participating in advance voting rises. Advance voting was piloted in 2013. The advance voting rate in the 2014 local elections was 11.49%, rising to 20.14% in 2018 and 20.62% in the 2022 local elections. Since last year’s presidential election, the NEC has been disclosing the number of advance voters per polling station on an hourly basis, due to some claims that the advance voter count was inflated. (선관위가 사전투표 받침대 재질과 디자인을 바꾼 것은 유권자 가운데 사전투표를 하는 비율이 높아지는 상황에서 각종 의혹을 불식하겠다는 취지다. 사전투표는 2013년 시범 도입됐는데, 2014년 지방선거 때 11.49%였던 사전투표율은 2018년 20.14%, 2022년 지방선거 때는 20.62%까지 높아졌다. 선관위는 지난 대선부터 투표소별 사전투표자 수를 1시간 단위로 공개하는데, 사전투표자수가 부풀려졌다는 일부 주장 때문이다.)

The NEC will expand the operation of the Fair Election Observation Group, first run in last year’s presidential election. Composed of figures from civic groups, professors, and other sectors, the observation group will monitor the entire election process on-site, including not only the voting and counting processes but also candidate registration, voter list preparation, submission of ballot return envelopes to the post office, and ballot box transport. Last year’s presidential election saw a group of 38 people operating in the Seoul, Incheon, and Gyeonggi metropolitan areas; this local election will expand it to 105 nationwide. (선관위는 지난해 대선 때 처음 운영한 공정선거참관단을 확대 운영한다. 시민단체 관계자, 교수 등 각계 인사로 구성된 참관단은 투·개표 과정뿐 아니라 후보자 등록, 선거인 명부 작성, 투표지 회송용 봉투 우체국 접수 절차 및 투표함 이송 등 선거 사무 전 과정을 현장에서 지켜볼 예정이다. 작년 대선 때 서울·인천·경기 등 수도권에서 38명 규모로 운영했는데 이번 지선에서는 전국(105명)으로 늘렸다.)

The NEC also plans to form its own ‘Voting Order Maintenance Special Response Team’ to prevent disturbances at advance polling stations. Among the 3,571 advance polling stations nationwide, 295 stations with many voters or where disruptions were expected during last year’s presidential election will have police officers deployed in teams of two. (선관위는 사전투표소에서 소란이 벌어지지 않도록 자체 ‘투표 질서 확립 특별 대응팀’도 구성하기로 했다. 전국 3571곳 사전투표소 가운데 지난 대선 당시 투표자가 많거나 소란이 예상되는 투표소 295곳에 2인 1조로 경찰이 배치된다.)

With official election campaigns starting on the 21st, the Democratic Party of Korea plans to actively encourage participation in advance voting. The People Power Party also announced that it has established a ‘Fair Election Safe Voting Committee’ and will conduct campaigns to encourage voting, including advance voting. (지난 21일 공식 선거운동이 시작된 가운데 더불어민주당은 사전투표 참여를 적극 장려할 계획이다. 국민의힘도 ‘공명선거 안심투표위원회’를 설치하고 사전투표를 포함해 투표 독려 운동을 벌인다고 밝혔다.)

Joint Planning by the National Election Commission and The Chosun Ilbo (중앙선거관리위원회·조선일보 공동 기획)

item.title: 17th Anniversary Memorial Service for Former President Roh Moo-hyun... Pro-government Figures Flock to Bongha Village (노무현 전 대통령 17주기 추도식... 범여권 일제히 봉하마을행)
item.description:
17th Anniversary Memorial Service for Former President Roh Moo-hyun... Pro-government Figures Flock to Bongha Village (노무현 전 대통령 17주기 추도식... 범여권 일제히 봉하마을행)

Political figures, including the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea, will gather on the 23rd in Bongha Village, Gimhae, South Gyeongsang Province, for the 17th anniversary memorial service marking the death of former President Roh Moo-hyun. The memorial service is set to be held solemnly at 2 PM that day at the former president's grave site and on a special stage at the Ecological Culture Park in Bongha Village. <<> From the Democratic Party, multiple members of the leadership will attend, including Chung Cheong-rae as General Co-Chair of the Election Committee, along with Co-Chairs Han Byung-do, Ahn Sun-ha, and Lee Bon-a; Co-Chairs Lee Un-ju, Hwang Myung-seon, Kang Deuk-gu, Lee Seong-yoon, Moon Jeong-bok, and Park Kyu-hwan; and General Director Cho Seung-rae. <<> The Fatherland Innovation Party will be represented by Cho Kuk as Senior Standing Co-Chair of the Central Election Committee, along with Lee Hae-min as General Director of the Election Committee, Baek Seon-hee as Election Committee Chair, and lawmaker Park Eun-jung. Han Chang-min, leader of the Social Democratic Party, will also attend. <<> Additionally, key figures from the pro-government camp, including former President Moon Jae-in, National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik, Minister of the Interior and Safety Yoon Ho-jung, Gyeonggi Governor Kim Dong-yeon, and South Jeolla Governor Kim Young-rok, will be present at the memorial service. <<> Former Prime Ministers Jung Sye-kyun and Han Myeong-sook, who serve as executives of the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation, will also attend. <<> Democratic Party mayoral candidate for Seoul, Jeong Won-oh, will not visit Bongha Village in person due to his local election campaign schedule, but plans to pay tribute to former President Roh via a live YouTube broadcast. <<> However, it has been reported that the People Power Party will not attend this year's memorial service at the leadership level. <<> This year's memorial service slogan is "Democracy in My Life, from the Square to the Village." item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk intensifies campaign in his district, also visits Daejeon MBC to protest ‘edited-out’ broadcast (장동혁, 지역구 찾아 집중유세…‘통편집’ 대전MBC 항의방문도)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk intensifies campaign in his district, also visits Daejeon MBC to protest ‘edited-out’ broadcast (장동혁, 지역구 찾아 집중유세…‘통편집’ 대전MBC 항의방문도)

People Power Party’s Standing Election Committee Chair Jang Dong-hyuk will hold an intensive campaign on the 23rd, the first weekend after the official start of the June 3 local election campaign, by visiting his own constituency of Boryeong and Seocheon in South Chungcheong Province. (국민의힘 장동혁 상임선대위원장은 6·3 지방선거 공식 선거운동 개시 후 첫 주말인 23일 자신의 지역구인 충남 보령·서천 등을 찾아 집중 유세에 나선다.)

Chairman Jang plans to tour areas including Boryeong Central Market and Seocheon Janghang Traditional Market on the morning of the 23rd, appealing for support from voters. He will then move to the Hanok Village in Jeonju, North Jeolla Province, to continue his campaign. (장 위원장은 이날 오전 보령 중앙시장과 서천 장항전통시장 등 지역 일대를 돌며 유권자를 향해 지지를 호소할 예정이다. 이어 전북 전주 한옥마을로 이동해 유세를 이어간다.)

Chairman Jang will also visit Daejeon MBC in person to protest after the broadcaster sparked controversy by deleting and airing only the opening remarks (about one minute) of his party’s candidate Kim Tae-heum during the broadcast of a recorded TV debate for the South Chungcheong governor race. (장 위원장은 또 충남지사 후보 TV 토론회 녹화본 방영 때 자당 김태흠 후보의 모두발언(1분)만 삭제·방영해 논란이 된 대전MBC에 직접 항의차 방문한다.)

During the central election committee meeting the previous day, Chairman Jang targeted Daejeon MBC, arguing, “This is a clear violation of election law and intentional election fraud. A thorough investigation must be conducted to uncover not only whether there were orders and involvement from higher-ups but also any connections with the Democratic Party.” (장 위원장은 전날 중앙선대위 회의에서 대전MBC를 겨냥해 “명백한 선거법 위반이자 고의적인 선거 부정이다. 윗선 지시와 개입 여부는 물론 민주당과의 커넥션까지 철저히 조사해 진실을 밝혀야 한다”고 주장했다.)

Daejeon MBC initially stated that it was “a mistake that occurred during the post-editing of a single NG cut from the recording process,” then changed its explanation to say it was “a mistake that happened while correcting an error in the caption for Candidate Kim’s name.” (대전MBC는 “녹화 과정에서 생긴 NG컷 1개를 후편집하는 과정에서 생긴 실수”라고 했다가, “김 후보 이름의 자막 오류를 바로잡는 과정에서 생긴 실수”라고 해명을 바꿨다.)

item.title: “We Should Help the President Since He’s Doing Well” vs. “Can’t Concentrate All Power on One Side” (“대통령 잘하니까 도와줘야쥬” vs “한쪽에 몰아줘서야 되겠슈”)
item.description:
“We Should Help the President Since He’s Doing Well” vs. “Can’t Concentrate All Power on One Side” (“대통령 잘하니까 도와줘야쥬” vs “한쪽에 몰아줘서야 되겠슈”)

“I’m still not sure yet. I’ll have to see when I go to the polling station.” (“아직 잘 몰라유. 투표장 가봐야 알쥬.”)

On the 21st, the first day of official campaigning for the June 3 local elections, many citizens encountered in Cheonan, Asan, Gongju, and Buyeo, South Chungcheong Province, said they had not yet decided who to vote for as governor of South Chungcheong. Kim Jeong-ja (79), who runs a clothing store at Gongju Sanseong Market, said, “They’re all the same,” adding, “Look around here—there’s no one in the market. I’ll pick a candidate who can really revive the economy.” In South Chungcheong, recent polls show a tight race between Park Su-hyeon of the Democratic Party and incumbent Governor Kim Tae-heum of the People Power Party, yet many residents remain undecided. “I’ll think it over a bit more and vote for whoever, whether ruling or opposition, helps us live well,” one said. <<> However, opinions among those intending to vote were sharply divided. Some said they would support the Democratic Party candidate to bolster President Lee Jae-myung, while others argued that checks on the government were necessary. <<> Lee Ji-yeon (35), a resident of Buldang New Town in Cheonan, said, “The president is doing a good job, isn’t he? I’m leaning toward the Democratic Party.” Lee Jeong-han (49), who works in electronic component manufacturing in the same area, added, “I think Park Su-hyeon can help the president.” Go Seon-ju (59), a private taxi driver in Cheonan, said, “I’m usually conservative, but the leadership of the People Power Party is so inept.” Choi (28), a worker met at Gongju University, said, “Still, since Park Su-hyeon is from Gongju, he’ll probably take better care of us.” <<> In contrast, Lee (68), a citizen met at Gongju Sanseong Market, said, “The president does well, sure. But can one side just take everything?” He added, “Although Park Su-hyeon was our district’s lawmaker, I’ll vote for Governor Kim Tae-heum this time for balance.” Choi (44), a merchant met in Buyeo, said, “With most regions turning Democratic, no matter how much I dislike it, I’ll vote for the People Power Party.” Kang Eun-cheol (61), who runs a restaurant in Dongnam-gu, Cheonan, said, “The government says it’s giving livelihood subsidies and high oil price support, but isn’t that all our taxes? I plan to back a conservative candidate.” <<> Support rates for candidates Park and Kim have been mixed in recent polls. Early in the campaign, Park led Kim by a double-digit margin outside the margin of error, but recently conservative voters have rallied, putting both candidates within the margin of error for first and second place. In a wireless ARS survey conducted by Realmeter for NewsPim on the 18th–19th and released on the 21st, Park had 43.5% and Kim had 43.9%. This was the first survey where Kim edged ahead of Park within the margin of error (±3.5 percentage points), recording a golden cross. In a phone interview survey by Korea Research for KBS conducted from the 16th–20th and released the same day, Park had 41% and Kim had 37%. However, with the undecided vote at around 10%, the election outcome in South Chungcheong—a traditional swing voter region—remains difficult to predict. <<> In Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang, where by-elections for the National Assembly are being held due to Park Su-hyeon’s gubernatorial bid, many citizens said they did not know who had even entered the race. Both Democratic candidate Kim Young-bin and People Power Party candidate Yoon Yong-geun are from the area, but are seen as unfamiliar faces. Recent polls show the two candidates neck and neck within the margin of error. Jeong Min-seo (22), a college student at Gongju University, said, “I don’t know the candidates well, but I dislike the authoritarian image of the conservative party, so I’ll vote for the Democratic candidate.” Jeon (54), a taxi driver in Buyeo, said, “I feel more drawn to Yoon Yong-geun of the People Power Party, since he’s from Buyeo.” Park (60), a Gongju High School graduate, said, “Both parties just parachuted in people no one knows from the center. I’ll vote for independent candidate Kim Hyeok-jong, who’s from Gongju.” (6.3 지방선거 공식선거운동 첫날인 지난 21일 충남 천안, 아산, 공주, 부여에서 만난 시민 상당수는 충남지사로 누구를 뽑을지 결정하지 못했다고 했다. 공주산성시장에서 옷 가게를 하는 김정자(79)씨는 “다 그놈이 그놈이유”라며 “여기 한번 보면 시장에 사람이 하나도 없슈. 경기 잘 살릴 수 있을 만한 후보로 뽑을겨”라고 했다. 충남은 최근 각종 여론조사에서 더불어민주당 박수현 후보와 현역 지사인 국민의힘 김태흠 후보가 초접전 양상을 보이고 있는 가운데, 실제 지역에선 아직 마음을 정하지 못했다는 부동층이 많았다. “조금 더 고민해보고 여(與)든 야(野)든 잘 먹고 잘살게 해주는 쪽에 투표하겠다”는 것이다.)

item.title: President Lee Orders Inspection of Fire Service Commissioner (李대통령 “소방청장 감찰하라”)
item.description:
President Lee Orders Inspection of Fire Service Commissioner (李대통령 “소방청장 감찰하라”)

The presidential office announced on the 22nd that President Lee Jae-myung has ordered an inspection of Fire Service Commissioner Kim Seung-ryong. Commissioner Kim was appointed to the position by President Lee in March of this year after former Commissioner Heo Seok-gon was dismissed amid suspicions of involvement in the December 3 martial law declaration. (이재명 대통령이 김승룡 소방청장에 대한 감찰을 지시했다고 청와대가 22일 밝혔다. 김 청장은 12·3 비상계엄 가담 의혹으로 허석곤 전 청장이 직위 해제되면서 이 대통령이 올 3월 소방청장에 임명했다.)

Senior Spokesperson Kang Yoo-jung made this announcement through a press release, stating that President Lee ordered an immediate fact-finding investigation. While the specific reason for the inspection was not disclosed, it is known to be "due to personal misconduct." The presidential office stated, "As the inspection has commenced, further specific details are difficult to provide," and declined to disclose additional information. Commissioner Kim also said in a phone call with the press that he "has no knowledge" of the reason for the inspection. There have been reports of confusion within the National Fire Agency as well. However, a source from the ruling party said, "I understand that suspicions regarding business expense misuse, abusive behavior, and inappropriate use of official vehicles have been raised in the past." <<> Just two days before the announcement of the inspection, on the 20th, Commissioner Kim received high praise from President Lee during a cabinet meeting for his achievements in wildfire prevention. At the meeting, President Lee told Commissioner Kim, "You have done a great job preventing major wildfires this winter." When Commissioner Kim reported key achievements such as improving the golden time arrival rate at disaster sites, advancing cutting-edge scientific firefighting with AI technology, and significantly reducing fire damage through prevention, President Lee reportedly asked, "Why didn't you mention that you have achieved such an incredible result in reducing large wildfires?" <<> On the 21st, Commissioner Kim delivered a keynote speech at the 2026 International Fire and Safety Expo in Daegu, announcing innovation strategies to realize a major transformation in firefighting. A native of Iksan, North Jeolla Province, Kim graduated from Hankuk University of Foreign Studies with a degree in German, entered the fire service through a competitive recruitment process for fire officers, and served as head of the Gangwon Special Self-Governing Province Fire Service Headquarters, director of the National Fire Agency's Equipment and Technology Bureau, and principal of the Central Fire Service Academy. Commissioner Kim served as acting fire service commissioner for six months starting from September last year, following the dismissal of former Commissioner Heo over suspicions of involvement in the December 3 martial law declaration. He was then appointed as the new fire service commissioner in March. At the time, the presidential office assessed that "Commissioner Kim had stably led the National Fire Agency during his six-month tenure as acting commissioner." (강유정 수석대변인은 이날 언론 공지를 통해 이같이 밝히며 이 대통령이 즉각적인 진상 확인을 지시했다고 전했다. 구체적인 감찰 이유는 공개되지 않았지만, ‘개인 비위로 인한 사유’로 알려졌다. 청와대는 “감찰에 착수한 사항이라 더 이상의 구체적인 설명은 곤란하다”며 이 밖의 사항에 대해서는 공개하지 않았다. 김 청장도 언론과의 통화에서 감찰 사유에 대해 “아는 바가 없다”고 했다. 소방청 내부에서도 당혹스럽다는 반응이 나오고 있다. 다만 한 여권 관계자는 “예전부터 업무추진비 의혹과 갑질 의혹, 관용차 부적절 이용 의혹 등이 거론돼 왔던 걸로 안다”고 했다.)

item.title: Park Geun-hye to Visit Daegu Chilseong Market with Choo Kyung-ho Today (박근혜, 오늘 추경호와 대구 칠성시장 찾는다)
item.description:
Park Geun-hye to Visit Daegu Chilseong Market with Choo Kyung-ho Today (박근혜, 오늘 추경호와 대구 칠성시장 찾는다)

Former President Park Geun-hye will join Choo Kyung-ho, the People Power Party candidate for mayor of Daegu, for an on-site campaign at Chilseong Market in Daegu's Buk-gu district at 2 PM on the 23rd. It has been reported that requests for Park's campaign support have also been made in battleground areas for the June 3 local elections, including Busan and Chungcheong. (박근혜 전 대통령이 23일 오후 2시 국민의힘 추경호 대구시장 후보와 함께 대구 북구 칠성시장 현장 유세에 나선다. 6·3 지방선거 여야 격전지인 부산과 충청 등에서도 박 전 대통령 유세 지원 요청이 이어지는 것으로 알려졌다.)

Choo Kyung-ho's campaign team announced in a media notice on the 22nd that "former President Park plans to spend about 30 minutes with candidate Choo greeting merchants." This marks the first time Park, who was impeached and removed from office by the Constitutional Court in 2017, has taken to the campaign trail for an election candidate. Choo has been consistently elected in Daegu's Dalseong district, serving as a three-term lawmaker, while Park also won four consecutive National Assembly elections in the same Dalseong district. (추경호 후보 캠프는 22일 언론 공지에서 “박 전 대통령이 30분 정도 추 후보와 함께 상인들께 인사드릴 예정”이라고 했다. 지난 2017년 헌법재판소 탄핵 결정으로 파면된 박 전 대통령이 선거 출마자를 위해 현장 유세에 나서는 건 처음이다. 추 후보는 대구 달성에서 내리 당선돼 3선 의원을 지냈고, 박 전 대통령도 대구 달성에서만 네 번의 국회의원 선거에 당선됐다.)

Kim Boo-kyum, the Democratic Party candidate for mayor of Daegu, has reportedly made several official requests to visit former President Park recently but has received no specific response. Kim and Choo have been locked in a tight race according to recent polls. A ruling party official commented, "Kim also moved because he is aware of the public sentiment in Daegu that supports former President Park," adding, "As Park joins hands with Choo, the likelihood of conservative supporters rallying together has increased." (더불어민주당 김부겸 대구시장 후보도 최근 여러차례 박 전 대통령 예방을 공식 요청했지만 별다른 답을 듣지 못했다고 한다. 김 후보와 추 후보는 최근 여론조사에서 초접전 양상을 보이고 있다. 여권 관계자는 “김 후보도 박 전 대통령을 지지하는 대구 민심을 알기에 움직였던 것”이라며 “박 전 대통령이 추 후보와 손을 잡으면서 보수 지지층이 결집할 가능성이 커졌다”고 했다.)

In the opposition camp, it has been speculated that former President Park might hit the campaign trail next week to support Kim Tae-heum, the pro-Park faction candidate for governor of South Chungcheong Province, and Lee Jang-woo, candidate for mayor of Daejeon. Yoo Young-ha, a lawmaker from the People Power Party and a close aide to Park, told this newspaper, "It's true that there are many requests for campaign support, but nothing has been decided yet." (야권에선 박 전 대통령이 다음 주에 친박계 출신 김태흠 충남지사 후보와 이장우 대전시장 후보의 지원 유세를 나갈 가능성이 거론됐다. 박 전 대통령 최측근인 국민의힘 유영하 의원은 본지에 “유세 지원 요청이 많은 건 사실이지만 아직 결정된 것은 없다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee: “Excessive Collection of Management Fees Is Now Illegal, Normalizing All Abnormalities” (李대통령 “관리비 과다징수는 이제 불법, 모든 비정상의 정상화”)
item.description:
President Lee: “Excessive Collection of Management Fees Is Now Illegal, Normalizing All Abnormalities” (李대통령 “관리비 과다징수는 이제 불법, 모든 비정상의 정상화”)

President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 23rd regarding improvements to the management fee system for multi-unit housing such as apartments, “Whether it’s apartments, officetels, or commercial buildings, excessive collection of management fees for shared-use buildings is now illegal.” (이재명 대통령은 23일 아파트 등 공동주택 관리비 제도 개선과 관련해 “아파트든 오피스텔이나 상가든 공동사용 건물에 대한 관리비 과다징수는 이제 불법”이라고 밝혔다.)

In a post on X (formerly Twitter) early that day, President Lee shared related news reports and wrote, “Anyone has the right to request a breakdown of management fees,” adding, “From now on, in South Korea, all abnormalities will be normalized.” (이 대통령은 이날 새벽 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 관련 보도를 공유하며 “누구든지 관리비 내역을 요구할 권리가 있다”며 이같이 적었다. 이 대통령은 그러면서 “이제부터 대한민국에선 모든 비정상이 정상화된다”고 했다.)

Earlier, on the 21st, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport announced a system improvement plan to eradicate corruption related to management fees. The plan raises the level of criminal punishment to prevent corruption by management entities such as administrative offices and removes exemption clauses that allowed avoidance of accounting audits without resident consent. (앞서 국토교통부는 지난 21일 관리비 관련 비리를 근절하기 위한 제도 개선안을 발표했다. 관리사무소 등 관리 주체의 비리를 막기 위해 형사처벌 수위를 높이고 입주자 동의에 따라 회계 감사를 받지 않도록 한 예외 규정을 삭제했다.)

President Lee had also criticized the issue of ‘overpriced’ management fees during a Cabinet meeting in February, stating, “Although concealed, this is actually close to a criminal act” and describing it as “a very bad act that could involve deception, fraud, or embezzlement.” (이 대통령은 지난 2월 국무회의에서도 관리비 ‘바가지’ 문제에 대해 “은폐돼 있지만 사실은 범죄 행위에 가깝다”며 “기망, 사기, 횡령일 수도 있는 아주 나쁜 행위”라고 비판했다.)

item.title: On the 17th Anniversary of Roh Moo-hyun’s Death... Ruling Party: “Complete Prosecution Reform”; Opposition: “Withdrawing Indictments Is Cheating” (盧17주기에... 與 “검찰개혁 완수” 野 “공소취소 반칙”)
item.description:
On the 23rd, the 17th anniversary of the death of former President Roh Moo-hyun, both the ruling and opposition parties called for carrying on the “Roh Moo-hyun spirit” in unison, but their aims differed. While the Democratic Party of Korea emphasized “completing prosecution reform,” the People Power Party countered, “Withdrawing the indictment in cases related to President Lee Jae-myung is reopening the era of cheating and privilege.” With the June 3 local elections approaching, the ruling and opposition parties are respectively highlighting the narratives of judging insurrectionist forces and judging the administration. <<> Han Byeong-do, co-chair of the Democratic Party’s joint election committee, cited former President Roh’s remark on Facebook that “the last bastion of democracy is the organized power of awakened citizens,” saying, “We used that power to stop the illegal December 3 martial law.” He added, “The Democratic Party is steadily completing the prosecution reform that the President wished for.” <<> He continued, “Like a river that never gives up on the sea, we will tirelessly strive to move toward a society without cheating and privilege.” <<> Song Eon-seok, co-chair of the People Power Party’s joint election committee, wrote on Facebook, “Looking at how the Democratic Party has recently referred to former President Roh, it seems less about ‘carrying on his legacy’ and more about ‘exploiting’ him.” <<> Song said, “The prosecution reform that former President Roh envisioned was about the political independence and neutrality of the prosecution, but what the Democratic Party is doing now is the administration’s takeover of the prosecution and the judiciary.” He added, “The move to withdraw President Lee’s indictment is precisely about reopening the ‘era where cheating and privilege are tolerated’ that former President Roh sought to end.” <<> Leaders of the Democratic Party and other pro-administration figures are gathering today at the memorial service for the 17th anniversary of former President Roh Moo-hyun’s death at Bongha Village in Gimhae, South Gyeongsang Province. In contrast, the leadership of the People Power Party will not attend the memorial service. Park Seong-hoon, spokesperson for the People Power Party’s central election committee, told reporters at the National Assembly, “While it is important to honor the spirit of remembrance, it is more important in this election to judge the arrogance and self-righteousness of the Lee Jae-myung administration and deliver a verdict at the ballot box.” (여야는 고(故) 노무현 전 대통령 서거 17주기인 23일 한목소리로 ‘노무현 정신’ 계승을 외치면서도 지향점은 달랐다. 더불어민주당이 “검찰 개혁 완수”를 강조한 것과 달리, 국민의힘은 “이재명 대통령 관련 사건 공소 취소는 반칙과 특권의 시대를 다시 여는 것”이라고 했다. 6·3 지방선거를 앞두고 여야가 각각 내란 세력 심판론, 정권 심판론을 부각한 것이다.)

item.title: Gyeongnam Governor Election... Heats Up Over Nepotism Hires and 'Druking' Issue (경남지사 선거… 친인척 채용·드루킹 두고 격화)
item.description:
Gyeongnam Governor Election... Heats Up Over Nepotism Hires and 'Druking' Issue (경남지사 선거… 친인척 채용·드루킹 두고 격화)

With just over ten days left until the June 3 Gyeongnam Province governor election, the race is increasingly intensifying into a negative campaign focused on attacking the morality and qualifications of opposing candidates. (6·3 경남도지사 선거가 열흘 남짓 남은 가운데 상대 후보의 도덕성과 자질을 집중 겨냥하는 네거티브 공방으로 점점 격화되고 있다.)

On the 22nd, during a legally mandated TV debate hosted by MBC Gyeongnam, Democratic Party candidate Kim Kyoung-soo and People Power Party candidate Park Wan-soo clashed head-on. (지난 22일 MBC경남에서 진행된 법정 TV 토론회에서 더불어민주당 김경수 후보와 국민의힘 박완수 후보가 정면 충돌했다.)

Candidate Kim raised allegations of nepotism hiring during Candidate Park's tenure as mayor of Changwon and president of Incheon International Airport Corporation. He pressed, "Every time you serve as the head of an institution, suspicions continue to arise over nepotism hiring—why do these doubts never stop?" Earlier, according to a press conference by a spokesperson for Kim's camp, Park's nephew is currently working as a first-level department head at the Gyeongnam Culture and Arts Promotion Agency, an organization funded by Gyeongnam Province. Kim's camp escalated its attack, claiming the nephew was hired as a first-level department head during Park's previous term as Gyeongnam governor. (김 후보는 박 후보의 창원시장과 인천공항공사 사장 시절 친인척 채용 의혹을 제기했다. 그는 “기관장으로 일할 때마다 친인척 채용을 둘러싸고 계속 의혹이 불거지는데 왜 이런 의혹이 계속 끊이지 않는 것이냐”고 따졌다. 앞서 김 후보 캠프 대변인의 기자회견에 따르면, 박 후보의 조카가 경남도 출연 기관인 경남문화예술진흥원에 1급 본부장으로 재직 중이다. 김 후보 캠프 측은 박 후보의 경남지사 재임 시기에 1급 본부장으로 채용됐다고 공세를 높였다.)

In response, Candidate Park countered, "All hires were made through lawful and proper procedures," adding, "In the case of Incheon International Airport Corporation, an investigation concluded there was no issue, and the recent nepotism allegations have nothing to do with me. I have already filed a complaint regarding this." (이에 박 후보는 “모두 다 적법하고 정당한 절차에 의해 채용됐다”며 “인천공항공사의 경우 수사를 통해 아무 문제가 없다는 결론이 났고, 최근 제기된 친인척 채용 의혹은 저와 상관없는 일이다. 이에 대해서는 고발 조치했다”고 반박했다.)

Candidate Park instead questioned the connection between the media outlet that first reported the allegations and Kim's camp. He said, "Isn't it true that a reporter who worked for *Minjung-ui Sori* is now working in Kim's camp? Recently, *Minjung-ui Sori* published a report based on an illegally obtained recording from over a decade ago," and added, "I have already filed complaints under the Information and Communications Network Act and the Public Official Election Act. It's suspicious whether this isn't a coordinated negative campaign by Kim's camp, the Democratic Party, and that media outlet." After the debate, Kim's camp stated through a comment, "Candidate Park Wan-soo's claim of a 'coordinated negative campaign' is a clear dissemination of false information," and "It is typical black propaganda aimed at giving residents the false impression that Kim's camp is systematically linked to media coverage. We plan to take legal action." (박 후보는 도리어 의혹을 처음 보도한 언론 매체와 김 후보 캠프 간의 연관성을 의심했다. 그는 “민중의소리에 근무했던 기자가 김 후보 캠프에서 일하고 있느냐. 최근 민중의소리는 10여 년 전 불법 도용된 녹취 보도를 했다”며 “이미 정보통신보호법과 공직선거법 위반 혐의로 고발했다. 김 후보 캠프와 민주당, 해당 매체가 합작한 네거티브가 아닌지 의심스럽다”고 했다. 김 후보 측은 토론회가 끝난 후 캠프 논평을 통해 “박완수 후보의 ‘합작 네거티브’ 발언은 명백한 허위 사실 유포”라며 “김 후보 캠프가 언론 보도와 조직적으로 연계된 것처럼 도민에게 허위 인식을 심어주려는 전형적인 흑색선전으로, 법적 조치할 예정”이라고 반박했다.)

Candidate Park also pressured Candidate Kim by bringing up the 'Druking' comment manipulation incident. Park asked, "Do you still think you're innocent? If you believe you're innocent even after the Supreme Court ruling, you're not a citizen of the Republic of Korea." Kim was convicted in the 2021 'Druking case' of manipulating public opinion via online comments, resulting in the loss of his governor position mid-term. He was later granted a special pardon and restoration of rights under the Yoon Suk Yeol administration. Kim explained, "I fulfilled my legal responsibilities according to the Supreme Court ruling." (박 후보는 김 후보의 드루킹 댓글 여론 조작 사건을 다시 거론하며 김 후보를 압박했다. 박 후보는 “아직도 무죄라고 생각하느냐. 대법원 판결까지 난 것을 무죄라고 생각한다면 대한민국 국민이 아니다”라고 했다. 김 후보는 2021년 댓글 여론 조작 사건인 ‘드루킹 사건’으로 유죄가 확정돼 임기 중 지사직을 잃었다. 윤석열 정부 때 특별사면·복권됐다. 김 후보는 “대법원 판결에 따라 법적 책임을 다했다”고 해명했다.)

When Candidate Park pointed out, "During the time of your trial and imprisonment for the Druking case, your assets actually increased from 700 million won to 1.8 billion won," Kim explained, "Just before I was incarcerated, my father-in-law passed away, and I received an inheritance. Also, many people bought my books during that difficult time." (박 후보는 “김 후보는 드루킹 사건으로 재판을 받고 복역한 기간에 오히려 재산이 7억에서 18억으로 늘었다”고 지적하자, 김 후보는 “수감 직전 장인어른이 돌아가시면서 상속이 있었고, 어려운 시기에 많은 분이 책을 사줬다”고 해명했다.)

Both sides also clashed over military service issues. Candidate Kim said, "I was exempted from military service after a physical exam due to an injured finger from factory work. I feel deeply dismayed that even this is being used as grounds for negative campaigning." In response, Candidate Park retorted, "Residents must clearly know who is engaging in negative tactics and who first raised the military service issue." (양측은 병역 문제를 두고도 공방을 벌였다. 김 후보는 “공장 활동에서 다친 손가락으로 인해 신체검사를 받고 병역 면제를 받았는데, 이런 것까지 네거티브의 사유로 삼는 데 대해 참담함을 금할 수 없다”고 말했다. 이에 박 후보는 “누가 네거티브하는지, 병역 문제를 누가 먼저 제기했는지 도민들이 잘 아실 것”이라고 받아쳤다.)

Previously, on the 18th, the Democratic Party's Gyeongnam Provincial Youth Committee raised suspicions concerning Candidate Park's past military service classification and changes in his family relations. At the time, the committee claimed, "Candidate Park, known to have been born as the youngest of two sons and three daughters, enlisted on February 19, 1977, citing being an 'only son,' and was discharged as a private after about seven months of service on September 17 of the same year," and argued, "A clear explanation is needed about any connection between the adoption process before enlistment and his military service classification." (앞서 지난 18일 민주당 경남도당 청년위원회는 박 후보의 과거 병역 판정과 가족관계 변경 과정을 문제 삼으며 의혹을 제기한 바 있다. 당시 청년위는 “2남 3녀 중 막내로 태어난 것으로 알려진 박 후보는 ‘독자’라는 이유로 1977년 2월 19일 입영해 같은 해 9월 17일 이병으로 약 7개월 만에 군 복무를 한 후 전역했다”며 “입영 전 양자 입적 과정과 병역 판정 사이에 어떤 관련이 있었는지 명확한 설명이 필요하다”고 주장했다.)

In response, Candidate Park's camp stated, "He was adopted in 1973 and received his military service classification as the son of his legal father, an uncle. He later enlisted as a one-year reserve service soldier and served about seven months. During his service, he was discharged as a private under the then-military service law provision for an 'only son whose father has passed away'—that is, a bereaved only son." (이에 박 후보 캠프 측은 “1973년 양자로 입양돼 당시 법적 친부였던 당숙부의 아들로 병역 판정을 받았다”며 “이후 1년 만기 방위병으로 입대해 약 7개월 복무했고, 복무 중 당시 병역법상 규정인 ‘부선망 독자’ 즉 아버지를 여읜 외아들 규정을 적용받아 이등병으로 전역했다”고 했다.)

They further countered, "Candidate Kim (in 1988) was classified as Second Citizen Service (now wartime labor service) due to a disease (stiffness in the proximal interphalangeal joint, an abnormality in the left finger) and did not serve in the military," and asked, "Isn't it fair to respect Kim's military service exemption as a legal judgment while turning Park's actual enlistment, service, and legal discharge into a matter of suspicion?" (그러면서 “김 후보는 (1988년) 질병(근위지절강직·왼쪽 손가락 이상)을 사유로 제2국민역, 현재 기준 전시근로역 판정을 받아 군 복무를 하지 않았다”며 “김 후보의 병역 미복무는 법적 판정으로 존중받고 박 후보의 실제 입대와 복무, 법정 전역은 의혹으로 몰아가는 것이 과연 공정하느냐”고 반박했다.)

During the TV debate, Progressive Party candidate Jeon Young-hee, who also participated, directed questions at both sides considering her position as a female governor candidate and the working-class vote. Jeon pointed out to Candidate Park, "Under Governor Park Wan-soo, the dedicated Women and Family Affairs Bureau had its functions significantly reduced, and the budget for preventing violence against women was cut by 30%." Park responded, "When I checked the budget, it actually increased," and added, "The Family Foundation expanded its functions, and there is also a Women's Policy Division." (이날 TV 토론회에 함께 나선 진보당 전영희 후보는 여성 도지사 후보, 노동계 표심을 감안한 질문을 양측에 퍼부었다. 전 후보는 박 후보를 향해 “박완수 도지사 때 전담 부서인 여성가족국은 과로 기능이 대폭 축소돼 여성 폭력 예방 예산이 30%나 삭감됐다”고 지적했다. 이에 박 후보는 “예산을 살펴보니 오히려 증액됐다”며 “가족재단은 기능을 확대했고 여성정책과도 있다”고 받아쳤다.)

Jeon also criticized Candidate Kim, saying, "Crucial workplace safety measures for labor sites were missing." Kim replied, "We need to create a system where companies that don't invest in worker safety face disadvantages." (전 후보는 또 김 후보에게는 “중요한 노동 현장 생명 안전 대책이 빠졌다”고 꼬집었고, 김 후보는 “노동자 생명과 관련해 안전에 투자하지 않는 기업은 손해를 볼 수 있게 만들어야 한다”고 답했다.)

Candidate Jeon pressured Candidate Park regarding the December 3 martial law declaration. She asked, "The Constitutional Court ruled that the 'December 3 martial law was a riotous insurrection and a serious violation of the constitutional order. Do you deny the Constitutional Court's ruling?" Park responded, "I said that the martial law situation was an unlawful martial law, and during the Constitutional Court's impeachment proceedings, as a People Power Party governor, I apologized to the residents for it," and added, "Whether it was an insurrection or not is currently under review in the second trial by the judiciary. I will state my position once the Supreme Court issues a final ruling." (전 후보는 12·3 비상계엄과 관련해 박 후보를 압박했다. 그는 “헌법재판소는 ‘12·3비상계엄은 폭동에 의한 내란이고 헌법 기본질서를 침해한 중대한 위법이라고 했는데 헌재 판결을 부정하느냐”고 물었다. 박 후보는 “계엄 상황은 위법적 계엄이라고, 헌재 탄핵 때는 국민의힘 도지사로서 도민들에게 죄송하다고 사과 말씀을 드렸다”며 “내란인지 아닌지는 사법부에서 2심이 진행 중이고 대법원 확정 판결이 나오면 입장을 밝히겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Jung Won-oh: "Half-Cut Rebar Also Caused Sampoong Disaster"... Targets Oh with 'Safety Issue' Offensive (정원오 “삼풍참사 원인도 반토막 철근”... 吳에 ‘안전 문제’ 공세)
item.description:
Jung Won-oh, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Seoul mayor, continued his offensive against People Power Party candidate Oh Se-hoon on the 23rd, linking the safety issue triggered by the "rebar omission" incident in the GTX-A Samsung Station section. (정원오 더불어민주당 서울시장 후보는 23일 GTX(수도권광역급행철도)-A 삼성역 구간의 ‘철근 누락’ 사태로 촉발된 안전 이슈를 고리로 국민의힘 오세훈 후보에 대한 공세를 이어갔다.)

On this first weekend of official campaigning for the June 3 local elections, Jung brought up the rebar omission incident during a street campaign in Eunpyeong-gu, Seoul, stating, "The rebar in the most critical pillars was omitted, resulting in half-cut rebar construction. Yet, the Seoul Metropolitan Government knew about this but allowed the construction to proceed." (정 후보는 6·3 지방선거 공식 선거운동 개시 뒤 맞은 첫 주말인 이날 서울 은평구에서 진행한 거리 유세에서 철근 누락 사태를 거론, “가장 중요한 기둥의 철근이 빠져서 반토막 철근 시공이 이뤄졌다”며 “그런데도 서울시는 이를 알면서도 공사가 진행되도록 내버려뒀다”고 했다.)

He then mentioned the 1995 Sampoong Department Store collapse, saying, "What will happen if a major disaster occurs later? Who will take responsibility? The biggest factor in that incident was the half-cut rebar construction." (그러면서 “나중에 큰 불상사가 생기면 어떻게 할 건가. 누가 책임질 건가”라며 1995년 삼풍백화점 붕괴 사고를 언급, “(당시 사고의) 가장 큰 요인이 철근 반토막 시공이었다”고 했다.)

Jung added, "I hope candidate Oh will head straight to Samsung Station and seek a solution. Otherwise, he will prove that it's no coincidence but inevitable that major safety incidents occur during every term of Mayor Oh Se-hoon, branding him as a mayor with safety insensitivity." (이어 “오 후보는 삼성역으로 바로 달려가서 해결책을 강구하기 바란다”며 “그렇지 않으면 안전 불감증 시장으로, 역대 안전 사고가 오세훈 시장 임기 때마다 터졌단 사실이 우연이 아닌 필연이라는 것을 스스로 증명하는 것”이라고 했다.)

He also listed the Itaewon disaster, the Umyeonsan landslide, the Gangnam Station flooding, and the sinkhole casualty in Gangdong-gu, saying, "We need to examine why such major disasters keep happening under Mayor Oh's watch. Shouldn't we change this safety insensitivity?" (또 이태원 참사, 우면산 산사태, 강남역 침수, 강동구 싱크홀 인명 사고 등을 나열하며 “왜 매번 오 시장 때 이런 대형 참사가 일어나는지 살펴봐야 한다”며 “(이런) 안전 불감증을 바꿔야 하지 않겠나”라고 했다.)

Regarding the real estate issue, which Oh has been focusing his attacks on, Jung highlighted his own "step-by-step development" pledge and the promise to supply 360,000 homes by 2031, saying, "I will deliver (the supply) faster and more safely. Please replace the mayor who only talks with one who takes action." (그는 또 오 후보가 공격을 집중하고 있는 부동산 문제와 관련, 자신의 ‘착착개발’ 공약과 ’2031년까지 주택 36만호 공급' 공약을 부각하며 “제가 더 빠르고 안전하게 (공급) 하겠다”며 “말로만 하는 시장을 바꿔주시고, 실천하는 시장을 뽑아달라”고 했다.)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon Attacks Jung over Seongdong-gu Redevelopment, Accusing Him of "Ignorance of Basics... Incompetence" (오세훈, 성동구 재개발 거론하며 鄭에 공세 “기초도 몰라...무능”)
item.description:
Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate for Seoul mayor, criticized on the 23rd that residents have suffered losses due to delays in redevelopment projects caused by administrative handling issues at the district office during the tenure of Democratic Party candidate Jung Won-oh as Seongdong-gu district chief. (오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보는 23일 더불어민주당 정원오 후보가 성동구청장 때 구청의 행정 처리 문제로 재개발 사업이 지연돼 주민들이 피해를 보고 있다고 비판했다.)

Oh visited Yangcheon-gu, where redevelopment and reconstruction issues are pressing, on the morning of that day, the first weekend of the official campaign for the June 3 local elections. At a campaign stop at Sinjeongnegeori, Oh stated, "In the Haengdang 7 district redevelopment complex in Seongdong-gu, final approval hasn't been granted, so 1,000 households can't register their properties. This is because the Seongdong-gu District Office, during Jung Won-oh's tenure as district chief, received 1.7 billion won in 2023 for children's center construction costs (as a cash donation), then returned the money in 2025 and suddenly demanded that the complex build the center on its own." <<> He said, "Without resolving this, he came out in March and started campaigning. He claims he does his job well, but does it seem that way? He's irresponsible, incompetent, and a cowardly liar." He added, "Can we entrust the reconstruction of 14 complexes in Mok-dong, Yangcheon-gu, to someone who doesn't even grasp the basics of redevelopment and reconstruction?" <<> Oh continued, "In Yangcheon-gu, besides Mok-dong, there are dozens of redevelopment and reconstruction complexes. I counted about 40." He further said, "I can't tolerate someone who can't even manage their own district claiming they'd do better if they were in charge." <<> In a meeting with reporters, Oh also addressed Jung's response to a proposal for a debate about the controversy over poor construction of the GTX-A (Great Train Express) line. Jung had stated, "Safety issues should be resolved through action, not by politicizing them." Oh retorted, "When we suggest discussing methodology to ensure safety, responding that way defies common sense." (오 후보는 6·3 지방선거 공식 선거운동 첫 주말인 이날 오전 재개발·재건축 문제가 현안인 양천구를 방문했다. 오 후보는 신정네거리 유세에서 “성동구 행당7구역 재개발 단지에 준공 승인이 나지 않아 1000가구가 부동산 등기를 못 하고 있다”며 “정원오 구청장 시절 성동구청이 2023년 어린이집 건설 비용(현금 기부채납)으로 17억원을 받아놓고, 2025년 돈을 돌려준 뒤 난데없이 어린이집을 직접 지으라고 했기 때문”이라고 했다.)
